items: Compliance with standards and directives: Unfortunately, even new machines often fail to meet current legal requirements. We verify and fix this.
Hazard elimination: Installation of physical mechanical guards, light curtains, laser scanners and safety interlocks that effectively prevent access to hazardous areas.
Modern control systems: Implementation of safe PLCs and drive systems that guarantee the proper operation of safety functions (e.g. immediate, safe stop).
Safety audit: Every comprehensive modernisation is preceded by a rigorous risk assessment to flawlessly identify and eliminate weak points.
Replacement of obsolete components: We remove old, difficult-to-maintain systems. We replace them with the latest PLCs, intuitive HMI panels, sensors and inverters
Integration with Industry 4.0: We prepare the machinery park for seamless data exchange with higher-level systems (MES/ERP). This opens the way for real-time diagnostics and remote servicing
Rapid diagnostics: Modern automation enables faster diagnosis of fault causes in seconds, drastically reducing downtime.
Increased efficiency: Mechanical modernisation enables the machine to operate faster and much more accurately.
Extended service life: We replace critical, worn parts (guides, drives, hydraulics), so you avoid the massive costs of purchasing a new machine.
Comprehensive refurbishment: We thoroughly refurbish old, worn-out machines, restoring them to 100% of their original technical working order.

blocks.text: Comprehensive modernisation (so-called retrofit) is the perfect combination of workplace safety and technical optimisation. We make old machines operate and look like new, whilst meeting the most stringent technical and legal standards.
Modernisation allows the updating or issuance of a completely new CE marking. Thanks to this, the machine can legally operate throughout the EU.
New, energy-efficient components noticeably reduce electricity bills and minimise expenses on continuous maintenance.
Modernised equipment simply does not break down. No breakdowns mean no downtime and peaceful execution of production plans
